Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		productCatalog: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(pc|pc.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer)
	postcondition:
		let newProductCatalog: ProductCatalog in
		productCatalog.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		newProductCatalog.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newProductCatalog) and
		newProductCatalog.Id = id and
		newProductCatalog.Name = name and
		result = true or
		productCatalog.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		productCatalog.Name = name and
		result = true
}
